faq.title: Common Questions About SOA Prep
faq.subtitle: Answering questions for beginners in the Actuary journey

q1.q: What is SOA and who is this certification for?
q1.a: SOA (Society of Actuaries) is the US professional organization for actuaries. SOA exams (like Exam P, FM) are the required first steps to become an Actuary - one of the highest-paying professions globally, for personnel in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, and Insurance.

q2.q: Which SOA Exam should I start with?
q2.a: Most candidates start with Exam P (Probability) or Exam FM (Financial Mathematics). At SOA Exam Practice, we provide adaptive question banks for both exams to help you optimize your study time.

q3.q: How much are SOA exam fees and tuition?
q3.a: Official SOA exam fees typically range from $250 - $350/exam (with student discounts). Regarding prep costs, SOA Prep offers practice packages that are over 80% cheaper than traditional textbooks, while continuously updating according to the 2026 syllabus.

description.p1: Vietnam Actuary Community (SOA Practice) is committed to supporting candidates preparing for preliminary exams. To achieve this, we provide online practice exams for selected preliminary exams. Completely free, these practice exams select questions and solutions in an online environment closely simulating the actual SOA exam format.
description.p2: Questions have been coded to meet exam learning objectives and ensure candidates receive a balanced but randomized set of questions each time they take a practice exam. Current questions are drawn from official sample question sources.
description.p3: The process used to create SOA actuarial exams from a large question bank is complex and considers many factors, including overall exam difficulty and coverage of learning objectives. Therefore, while falling within the scope of exam learning objectives, questions in these practice exams may not represent the average difficulty of an actual exam.
description.p4: If you have questions or encounter technical difficulties with the online practice exam, please contact us via email.
